r.s: PHP5 Resolver library used to communicate with a DNS server.
r.d:
Provides (roughly) the same functionality as Net_DNS, but using PHP5 objects, exceptions for error handling, better sockets support.
This release is (in most cases) 2x - 10x faster than Net_DNS, as well as includes more RR's (including DNSSEC RR's), and improved sockets and streams support.
r.n: - added some trimming of whitespace to Net_DNS2_RR::buildString(); we'd get some Uninitialized string offset errors if there was some blank space at the end. - fixed a few cases where Net_DNS2_Lookup where it should Net_DNS2_Lookups - added support for a strict query mode, that lets you handle the weird way DNS handles failed lookups + CNAME recors; see RFC 1034 section 3.6.2 for more information. - fixed some warning messages that were coming from the cache classes when a json_decode() would fail. - fixed a bug in Net_DNS2_Cache_File and Net_DNS2_Cache_Shm; it would try to write the file even if caching was turned off - made sure we don't cache records when we do a zone transfer - added some blocking in both the Sockets.php and Streams.php file around the read function - I wasn't handling multi-message zone transfers properly; now we loop through and read all the messages and pack them together as one big result
